results.title: Major demolition drive in Mankhurd, dozens of 'illegal' warehouses removed
results.description: According to the statement, the demolished warehouses were illegally constructed beneath high-voltage Tata Power transmission lines near the highway in Mankhurd, falling under Kurla taluka

results.title: Floodwaters Enter Homes at Dawn, Jajpur Families Struggle to Survive on Dry Food
results.description: #ମ ୁଣ୍ଡୁଳୀରେ_କଡ଼ା_ସୁରକ୍ଷା #ପ ାଣି_ପାଖକୁ_ଯିବାକୁ_ମନା ମୁଣ୍ଡୁଳୀରେ କଡ଼ା ସୁରକ୍ଷା। ଲୋକମାନେ ବନ୍ୟାପାଣି ଦେଖିବାକୁ ଆସୁଥିବା କାରଣରୁ ପୋଲିସର ପ୍ରହରା। ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ନ ଆସିବାକୁ କହିବା ସହ ପାଣି ପାଖକୁ ନଯିବା ପାଇଁ କହିଲେ କଟକ ଡିସିପି। Flood-affected residents of Jajpur have narrated their ordeal after floodwaters entered their homes at daybreak, leaving families stranded and struggling for basic necessities. With normal cooking and access to food disrupted, many people say they are surviving only on dry food while facing severe hardship.
